patches.purpose: ro.hardware.gralloc=bst + ro.hardware.egl=emulation. init.sh init_hal_gralloc() 漏设 gralloc(只设 egl); 不设则 hw_get_module 找不到 gralloc.bst.so(fallback gralloc.default.so 已被 prune)→ NULL → hwcomposer.default.so SIGSEGV
patches.quality: TEMP (build.prop append, reliable 2026-07-20): init.sh init_hal_gralloc() PROVEN INEFFECTIVE — init.sh runs AFTER hwcomposer inits -> gralloc unset at hwcomposer init -> SIGSEGV x830. build.prop loaded very early by init (before HALs) -> append reliable. Formal fix (Phase 2, needs rebuild) = PRODUCT_PROPERTY_OVERRIDES += ro.hardware.gralloc=bst in bst_x86_64.mk (bakes into build.prop at build time).
patches.impact: 图形 HAL 链 gralloc/hwcomposer 初始化; 不修则 hwcomposer SIGSEGV 96×

patches.purpose: service.cpp bypass A16 HIDL 自杀(commit 523130f: getTransport(IServiceManager)==EMPTY → 判定 HIDL 不支持 → 设 disabled 自杀). bypass = if(false). 不修则 hwservicemanager 自杀 → 所有 HIDL HAL SIGABRT 注册失败
patches.quality: TEMP DIAG (verified 2026-07-20 must stay): VINTF level patch(libhidl_vintf) RUNTIME INSUFFICIENT — device manifest target-level=legacy filters framework hidl.manager max-level=8 at runtime -> getTransport(IServiceManager)==EMPTY -> hwsm self-disable (disabled=true set, HAL SIGABRT 411). DIAG if(false) forces supported; A16DBG:HWSM transport log (outside dead branch). Formal fix (Phase 2) = change device manifest target-level OR device-side manifest (NOT framework max-level).
patches.impact: hwservicemanager 存活 → 所有 HIDL HAL(keymaster/configstore/health/drm/hwcomposer)能否注册
patches.verification: hwservicemanager has pid 443 存活; HAL SIGABRT 156→0; boot 到 launcher
